name: Human Resources
description: Attracts, develops, and retains top talent while fostering a positive, inclusive workplace culture

roles.name: HR Manager
roles.description: Leads HR operations and develops strategies to support organizational growth and employee satisfaction
responsibilities: Develop and implement HR strategies and policies
Manage talent acquisition and recruitment processes
Foster positive workplace culture and employee engagement
Ensure compliance with employment laws and regulations

roles.name: Talent Acquisition Specialist
roles.description: Attracts and recruits top talent aligned with organizational needs and culture
responsibilities: Develop recruitment strategies and sourcing plans
Screen and interview candidates for various positions
Build relationships with potential candidates and recruitment partners
Manage the candidate experience and onboarding process

roles.name: Employee Development Specialist
roles.description: Develops and implements employee training and development programs
responsibilities: Design and deliver employee training and development programs
Manage performance evaluation and career development processes
Create succession planning and leadership development initiatives
Support employee growth and skill development

plan.prompt: Develop a comprehensive talent management strategy to attract, develop, and retain top talent.
Create recruitment and sourcing strategies to attract the right talent for the organization.
Design employee development and training programs to support talent growth and retention.
Finalize the integrated talent management strategy with performance metrics and success criteria.
